guidance.bestFor: Task cards with priority, assignee and due date, dragged as a dashed placeholder box between reorderable columns
agentNotes: Column headers read `COLUMN_TITLES` by key, so a new key in `columns` needs a title entry or its header is blank

whenNotToUse.when: A board whose moves must reach a server and roll back on failure
Drags that should show the card itself under the pointer

guidance.bestFor: A live copy of the dragged card or whole column under the pointer, drawn by an overlay function
Frame columns with a status icon and count over label cards, where only the cards drag
agentNotes: A key in `columns` with no `COLUMNS` entry shows its raw key as the title and no status icon

whenNotToUse.when: Columns that the user should also drag into a new order

guidance.bestFor: Stacked Frame columns with a one line description each, over cards with a progress bar and assignee
agentNotes: Column titles print the raw `columnId` key and each `FrameDescription` text is hardcoded per key

guidance.bestFor: A product roadmap of feature cards with description, progress bar and vote count across color coded stages
agentNotes: Each key in `columns` needs an entry in `COLUMNS`; an unknown key throws when the header reads `col.color`

name: c-kanban-6
title: Kanban board persisted to a backend
label: Persisted Moves
description: Persist moves with onValueCommit, optimistic updates, and Sonner rollback

guidance.bestFor: Drops saved to a simulated API, with a loading toast and a rollback to the previous board on failure
agentNotes: Replace `persistBoard`, which fails at random on 1 call in 4, with your API call; on failure `handleValueCommit` restores `previousValue`
`toast` from `sonner` shows nothing unless your app mounts the Sonner toaster
